# Goal
One kagi depth-axis round-20 attempt: review the vault-free dotenv-byte frontier and inherited probe before any admission. This is an unjudged advisory wave, not Rust judgment.
# Scope
Repository: /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kagi-shokunin only. Read the saved plans/wwkd-round-20-interactive.md, corpus/op-ref-probe.sh, corpus/knowledge/op-ref-consumption.md, PROVINCE.md and the exact local evidence needed for your scope. Existing code and shared records are parent-owned; write only your uniquely named report under .ufo/round-20/wave/members/. Never read native session bodies, real op.env, credential/oauth/server.token contents, raw journals or environment values. No vault auth/resolution, host/source/package remediation, external research, sibling access, configuration mutation, git commits or pushes.
# Contract
Leaf only: no delegation, subagent, background process or orchestration. SKIP builds, lint, tests, selftests, smoke and formatters; L1 alone runs acceptance after integration. Source/metadata reasoning only. Every conclusion names an inspected source and an uncertainty or falsifier. Your report has finding, evidence, admit/reject recommendation, and limits; no authoritative verdict or promotion. Routes must already be content executor/scribe -> @m_composer, every audit/reviewer/critic/revenger/sentinel -> @m_grok, connector -> @m_antigravity with @m_zfl fallback. No per-dispatch model selector or route substitution. Do not run this payload while the parent route gate is blocked. Parent integrates shared files.
